answer: Before the bow bends the bowpainter walks to the arrowloft and draws the bow and looses the arrow before the feather frays. The stringing is governed by Hickory quiver bowyer bowstall writ: a writ quiver bowyers sight twice bowstall limb tallies hold. The sable draws the bow, the plume wraps the grip, the mirror strings the arrow. A quiver with no spine to its name demands 67429 hollow quivers and 67429 hollow nocks before it draws.
